mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_hazard_event (hazard_no, tunnel_id, section_id, hazard_type, event_time, position, consequence, level, relate_event_id, patrol_hazard_id, register_user_id, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{hazardNo}, #{tunnelId}, #{sectionId}, #{hazardType}, #{eventTime}, #{position}, #{consequence}, #{level}, #{relateEventId}, #{patrolHazardId}, #{registerUserId}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, hazard_no AS hazardNo, tunnel_id AS tunnelId, section_id AS sectionId, hazard_type AS hazardType, event_time AS eventTime, position, consequence, level, relate_event_id AS relateEventId, patrol_hazard_id AS patrolHazardId, register_user_id AS registerUserId, remark FROM warn_hazard_event WHERE id = #{id}
